subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs be collected now with the existing fail-closed SecretRef behavior, or should this wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy to land?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it changes which credential refs are materialized before TTS runs and can make missing persona TTS refs fail earlier than they do today.

options.title: Accept current fail-closed consistency
options.body: After real behavior proof is added, merge this as the persona equivalent of the existing top-level TTS SecretRef behavior and track optional degradation separately.

options.title: Coordinate with optional TTS degradation
options.body: Hold this until the optional TTS SecretRef startup policy in the related PR is accepted or merged so persona refs do not widen startup-fatal behavior.

options.title: Narrow or pause the PR
options.body: Ask for a narrower change if maintainers do not want new persona SecretRef resolution until the credential policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept current fail-closed consistency
recommendation.body: After real behavior proof is added, merge this as the persona equivalent of the existing top-level TTS SecretRef behavior and track optional degradation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the SecretRef runtime framework and command secret target semantics this person introduced in the broad coverage work.
